title: Graduate Engineer - next Graduate Development Program intake (Civil stream)
content_text: Decmil Graduate Development Program: 18-month hands-on program across engineering, sustainability/environment and commercial streams in Victoria, WA and Queensland. Civil Engineering, Construction Management and Project Management graduates for Graduate Engineer stream with site engineer pathway. Mentors, six-monthly performance reviews, permanent offer on successful completion. Eligibility: final-year university study or recent graduate in listed disciplines; Australian/NZ citizen, Australian PR, or full-time work visa. 2026 intake applications closed November 2025 (program began February 2026). Standing careers page still invites graduate interest; people.culture@decmil.com.au published for graduate program information. This is a speculative enquiry for the next open intake, not a claim that the 2026 cohort is still recruiting.
apply_instructions: Register via Decmil careers when the next intake opens; for program information contact people.culture@decmil.com.au (published on Decmil Graduate Program 2026 PDF).

title: Graduate Engineer
content_text: Graduate Engineer Location Brisbane QLD Full time. Join Diona project delivery team Brisbane. Specialists in cable laying, water, sewer and gas pipelines, drainage and concrete construction. Requirements: Bachelor of Civil Engineering or equivalent. Ability to communicate and liaise effectively. Good time management. Excellent written and oral communication. Apply via LiveHire portal.
